اهتلكتا (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكَتَا (ihtalakatā) /ih.ta.la.ka.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اُهْتُلِكَتَا (uhtulikatā) /uh.tu.li.ka.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
